description: This file defines the Notification model class for the Opencart admin tool. It provides methods to add, edit, delete, retrieve, and count notifications stored in the database.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Model class for managing notifications in the Opencart admin system, providing CRUD operations and retrieval functions.

methods.name: addNotification
methods.description: Creates a new notification record in the database with given data.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a specified notification in the database.

methods.name: deleteNotification
methods.description: Deletes a notification record from the database by ID.

methods.name: getNotification
methods.description: Retrieves a specific notification record by ID.

methods.name: getNotifications
methods.description: Retrieves a list of notifications, optionally filtered by status and paginated.

methods.name: getTotalNotifications
methods.description: Returns the total count of notifications, optionally filtered by status.
